0022600121.text: The Bulls (1-1, 2nd in the Central, 1 game back, 8th in the East) visit the Celtics (1-1, 3rd in the Atlantic, 1 game back, 7th in the East), with both teams riding a one-game winning streak. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head, bruise), and Patrick Williams (groin, soreness), while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost the season series 1-2, including a 124-105 defeat in Boston on February 11, 2026.
